title: BsScoreFindings
description: Contract for LLM-emitted bs_score findings. bs-score enforces this schema in full (types, enums, minLength, numeric bounds, additionalProperties) before scoring.

version.description: Payload contract version. 2 is current; 1 is still accepted.

target_kind.description: Review type. Selects the weight profile in scoring.json.

target_ref.description: Optional locator: repo URL or commit, PR/branch, review id, skill path, agent path, or prompt-set name.

audit.description: Optional proof that the audit went deep. bs-score checks the listed files exist, measures coverage against the tree, and stamps the report 'shallow' when a review type that requires a code pass never read code.

files_read.description: Repo-relative paths actually opened during the audit.

path.description: Evidence locator. File form: README.md, src/api.py:88, src/api.py:88-95. Review form: pull/<n>/reviews/<id>[#suffix]. Prompt form: prompt:<prompt-id>[:<line>] resolved against --prompts, or a plain file path when the prompt is stored in the repo.

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the artifact at `path`. Verified byte-for-byte (whitespace-normalised) by bs-score --repo-root; a quote that is not present is not scored.

claim.description: Optional: the stated claim being audited.

cluster.description: Optional root-cause id. Findings sharing (type, cluster) collapse into one scored finding with the rest recorded as merged reports — so one defect worded several different ways costs its points once.

confidence.description: Display-only; does not affect the score.
